Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used GFP-tagged reporter cell lines for affinity purification (pulldown) followed by DDA and LFQ proteomics to identify protein-protein interactions.

scope: Pulldown followed by mass spectrometry were used to determine protein-protein interactions
To identify the functional partners of SNRPD2, SNRPD3 and NHP2L1, we performed GFP pulldown followed by mass spectrometry proteomics on the three different GFP-fusion cell lines.

lysates were added to 20 µl GFP-Trap A beads suspension (Chromotek) and uncubated for 1.5 hours at 4°C under rotation. For mass spectrometry, beads were washed twice with 1 ml EBC buffer containing 150 mM NaCl and twice with 1 ml 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate.
